title: Asahina Mafuyu — The Truth Comes Out〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, your dad should be coming over soon. Which tea do you think I should make today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sorry, what did you just say...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I was just thinking about brewing some tea. We have chamomile and a bunch of other varieties.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know that I should go home...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And if I don't, my dad has to keep...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay for you to take things slow, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I think he's allowing you to stay here because he feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, that might be him...
I'll go check...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I feel like I've been resting for too long. It's been two hours since Dad left...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay for you to tell me whatever it is that's on your mind, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually like this cake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to taste anything for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Should I have told him those things...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I even told him how I couldn't taste that cake...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I should eat it sooner rather than later...
But Kanade might be working right now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you feel better after resting...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is something on your mind, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm...
Are you worried about telling him how you couldn't taste this cake?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: He said he wanted to know how I really felt...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But that might've just caused him to worry even more...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your dad has every right to be surprised after hearing that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But he also said that he'll be back to see you again next week...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, for now, I think you should feel good about telling him.
